title: Why watching cashflow is mission critical

hook.title: Hook
hook.keywords: bankrupt in March, a million in April, one month off
hook.script: Picture a company that goes bankrupt in March. Its biggest deal, a million dollars, lands in April. The numbers were fine. The timing was one month off. I want to show you why that happens, and what you do about it before it happens to you.

todays-route.title: Today's route
todays-route.keywords: four steps, your cash, what sales is, how to start, start when?
todays-route.script: We take four steps today. First, you see your cash. Second, you see what sales really is. Third, you learn how to start. Fourth, you see why a pipeline takes time to build. Then one question decides it all: start when?
